name: Broome
tagline: Camels at sunset on Cable Beach
summary: Broome is a pearling town on the edge of the Kimberley with turquoise water and red cliffs. Ride camels along Cable Beach at sunset, see the Staircase to the Moon on the tidal flats, find dinosaur footprints at Gantheaume Point, watch films at the world's oldest outdoor cinema and learn the pearling history of Chinatown.
seasonNote: Dry season May to October; the wet season is hot, humid and stormy.
gettingAround: Hire car or the town bus.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; tipping isn't expected.
foodTip: Barramundi, mud crab and Asian-influenced pearling food.
